title: Large-Scale Mechanisms Driving Atmospheric Monsoons
exact_target: Explain the dynamical mechanisms driving the seasonal large-scale monsoon circulation.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001528 (OWR-4415-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean-Science (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/34, pp. 2027--2099; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 11--12.

status_qualification: This is a mechanism question for Earth's atmosphere, not a single quantified theorem with a fixed model and observable. The report develops a proposed explanation; it does not imply that a universal necessary-and-sufficient monsoon condition is already defined.
